Subject: Redline + Onboard: propose splitting MSA redline and onboarding checkpoint

Hi Elena / John —

Thanks for the intake earlier. To make the review efficient on both sides, would ClearTide be open to splitting the conversation into two shorter sessions:

1) MSA redline walk (legal + contract owners) — focused on outstanding clauses/alternate language (30–45m)
2) Vendor onboarding + technical intake (procurement + SSO engineer) — focused on evidence, SSO, and implementation runbook (30m)

We've attached the current MSA_redline_DRAFT_v2.docx so you can flag priority items ahead of the call.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Thu Apr 22: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Fri Apr 23: 09:00–11:00 (open)

If those don't work, send 2–3 slots that do and we'll coordinate. Laura (cc) will run the legal session; I’ll own the onboarding checkpoint.

Agenda stub: 1) redline anchor points, 2) risk/requirement decisions, 3) follow-up action owners.

Thanks —
